catalog_evidence: EVDS catalog https://evds3.tcmb.gov.tr/igmevdsms-dis/categories/withDatagroups/type=json and per-group serieList/fe endpoints, retrieved 2026-09-23. Cpi: bie_tukfiy2003 'Consumer Price Index (General) (2003=100)', TURKSTAT, monthly, updated 22-09-2026. TaxRevenue: bie_kbmgel 'Central Government Budget Revenues - New Definition', Ministry of Treasury and Finance, monthly, unit 'thousand TRY', updated 22-04-2026; TP.KB.GEL003 is line 'I. Taxes'. PublicDebt: bie_kbicborc 'Domestic Debt Stock', monthly, unit 'thousand TRY'; TP.KB.A09 is line '5.Total'. InterestRate: bie_bispolfaiz 'Central Banks' Policy Interest Rate', BIS, monthly, unit 'Percentage'; TP.BISPOLFAIZ.TUR is the Türkiye entry.

series.definition: TURKSTAT Consumer Price Index, general index, base 2003=100. An index level, not a rate of change: year-on-year inflation must be derived by the consumer, not stored here. TURKSTAT also publishes a rebased 2025=100 series (bie_tukfiy2025); mixing the two bases in one column would be a break in series.

Central government budget revenues, line 'I. Taxes' (tax revenue only, excluding non-tax revenue and capital revenue). Monthly flow, not cumulative year-to-date, under the 'New Definition' presentation. Source unit is thousand TRY; scale 1000 converts to base TRY units.

Domestic debt stock, line '5.Total'. This is the DOMESTIC debt stock only: external debt is a separate EVDS group (bie_brutdbalckamu, reported in million USD) and is deliberately not added in, because summing a TRY stock and a USD stock requires an explicit FX convention. Source unit is thousand TRY; scale 1000 converts to base TRY units.
Central bank policy interest rate for Türkiye as published in the BIS policy-rate dataset, monthly. Stored as a percentage number (e.g. 40.0 means 40%), not a decimal fraction.
